clue.text: Feeling of panic produced by variable speed limit

indicators.note: something variable is changeable, so the letters of speed are rearranged

parts.note: a ration is a fixed limit on how much one may have

explanation.surface: A driver panics on a road where the speed limit keeps changing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'variable' makes DESPE from SPEED; 'limit' is a noun here, RATION.
explanation.definitionFit: Desperation is the hopeless, frantic state in which panic takes hold, so it names that feeling.

clue.text: Investigate former leader of party's traditional knowledge

parts.note: ex- is the prefix for a former partner or holder of a post

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter, here of party

parts.note: lore is the body of traditional knowledge passed down

explanation.surface: Someone digs into the folk wisdom of a party's ex-leader.
explanation.definitionFit: To explore something is to examine it thoroughly, a synonym of investigate.

clue.text: Had to be under a spell

definitions.meaning: had in the sense of owned or held
bewitched, controlled by a spirit or demon

explanation.surface: Someone was forced to fall under an enchantment.
explanation.definitionFit: Possessed means both owned (past tense of a verb of ownership) and bewitched by a spirit.

clue.text: Ceremonies requiring legal freedoms on the radio

indicators.note: radio is heard rather than seen, so the word is taken by its sound

parts.note: rights are freedoms guaranteed by law

explanation.surface: Ceremonies broadcast on air that call for civil liberties.
explanation.definitionFit: Rites are formal religious or ritual ceremonies, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Victim panics, concealing drums

indicators.note: the phrase Victim panics holds the letters within it, keeping them out of sight

explanation.surface: A panicking victim hides the drums.
explanation.definitionFit: Timpani are kettledrums, the large tuned drums of an orchestra.

clue.text: Finished with time to pack a cold ham

indicators.note: time is the last item packed in at the back of the sequence

parts.note: something over is finished or ended
C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps

explanation.surface: Done, with time to wrap up a cold leg of ham.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ham' is a verb here, not the meat.
explanation.definitionFit: To ham is to perform with exaggerated theatricality, which is exactly overacting.

clue.text: Equivalent role supporting bar

indicators.note: in a down answer, the role sits below the bar, holding it up

parts.note: a counter is the bar over which drinks are served
a part is an actor's role

explanation.surface: An equivalent supporting role, as an actor might be cast.
explanation.definitionFit: A counterpart is a person or thing that corresponds to another, its equivalent.

clue.text: Flight of celebrities across north of Italy

indicators.note: the celebrities stretch across the letter, holding it inside

parts.note: stars are famous people

indicators.note: in a down clue the north of a word is its top, its first letter

explanation.surface: Celebrities fly across the north of Italy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flight' means a flight of stairs, not air travel.
explanation.definitionFit: A flight is a continuous series of steps between floors, a set of stairs.

clue.text: Company rejected best American swimmer

indicators.note: rejected means thrown back, so the letters of company are turned round

parts.note: top means best, as in top marks
US stands for United States, so American

explanation.surface: A firm turns down the best American swimmer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'swimmer' is any creature that swims, not an athlete.
explanation.definitionFit: An octopus is a sea creature that swims, so it is a swimmer in crossword fashion.

clue.text: Moderate anger

definitions.meaning: a verb, to tone down or soften
a noun, a fit of rage or bad mood

explanation.definitionFit: To temper is to moderate or soften; a temper is a fit of anger.

clue.text: Current queue head of distribution must make efficient

parts.note: a stream is a current of water
a line is a queue of people

indicators.note: the head of a word is its opening letter, here of distribution

explanation.surface: A manager says the current queue at the head of distribution must be made efficient.
explanation.definitionFit: A streamlined process has been simplified to run smoothly, so it is efficient.

clue.text: Sound around the centre of Rome is offensive

indicators.note: the noise surrounds the letters taken from Rome

parts.note: noise is sound

indicators.note: the centre of Rome is its two middle letters

explanation.surface: Noise around central Rome is unpleasant.
explanation.definitionFit: Noisome means offensive or disgusting, especially of a smell; it has nothing to do with noise.

clue.text: Area of water left worker needing material for fixing leaks

parts.note: a sea is a large area of salt water
a worker ant, the crossword's favourite worker

explanation.surface: A worker left at sea needs something to plug the leaks.
explanation.definitionFit: Sealant is a substance applied to close gaps and stop water getting through.

clue.text: Make certain, ignoring right result

indicators.note: ignoring means leaving out, so the letter for right is dropped

parts.note: to ensure is to make certain

explanation.surface: Make sure, ignoring the right outcome.
explanation.definitionFit: To ensue is to follow as a consequence, to result.

clue.text: Struggle in New Street to get linen item

indicators.note: the struggle goes inside the rearranged street
something new is made afresh, so the letters of Street are rearranged

parts.note: to vie is to compete or struggle

explanation.surface: A fight on New Street over a piece of linen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'New Street' reads as a road name, but 'New' is the anagram signal and 'in' places the struggle inside the result.
explanation.definitionFit: A serviette is a table napkin, traditionally a piece of table linen.

clue.text: Introduce changes for cut in capacity

indicators.note: changes means alters, so the letters of Introduce are reshuffled

explanation.surface: A firm announces changes that will cut its capacity.
explanation.definitionFit: A reduction is a lowering or cut, here in the amount something can hold.

clue.text: Left on board, finished forecast

parts.note: port is the left side of a ship, on board being nautical
ended means finished

explanation.surface: A sailor left on board when the voyage finished predicts the weather.
explanation.definitionFit: Portended is a past tense meaning foretold or forecast, as an omen does.

clue.text: Run out and play the guitar, seeing stage

parts.note: RO is the cricket scorecard abbreviation for run out, a way a batter is dismissed
to strum is to play a guitar by sweeping the strings

explanation.surface: A musician runs out to play guitar on a stage.
explanation.walkthrough: RO is how a cricket scorecard records a batter who is run out.
explanation.definitionFit: A rostrum is a raised platform for a speaker or conductor, a small stage.

clue.text: Australian runner delayed delivering copy

parts.note: the emu is a flightless Australian bird that runs fast
late means delayed

explanation.surface: A late Australian sprinter delivers a copy.
explanation.definitionFit: To emulate is to imitate someone, to copy them in order to match them.

clue.text: Go away from Sweden and study intensively

parts.note: S is the international vehicle code for Sweden
to cram is to study hard just before an exam

explanation.surface: A student leaves Sweden to swot for exams.
explanation.definitionFit: Scram is a slangy command meaning leave at once, get out.

clue.text: Amended atlases to show product of the oceans

indicators.note: amended means changed, so the letters of atlases are put in a new order

explanation.surface: Revised atlases show what the oceans produce.
explanation.definitionFit: Sea salt is obtained by evaporating seawater, so it comes from the oceans.

clue.text: Radio broadcast key for member of crew

indicators.note: broadcast also means scattered, so the letters of Radio are scattered

parts.note: E is a musical key

explanation.surface: A radio broadcast is key for a crew member.
explanation.definitionFit: A roadie is part of the crew that sets up and moves a touring band's equipment.

clue.text: Engineers fathom echo

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British Army corps
to sound is to measure the depth of water, as to fathom

explanation.surface: Engineers measure depth by echo.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fathom' is a verb meaning measure depth, not understand.
explanation.definitionFit: To resound is to ring out or reverberate, which an echo does.

clue.text: Performers expected tips, but not taking single penny

parts.note: due means expected, as a train is due

indicators.note: the letters for single and penny are left out of tips

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one, a single

explanation.surface: Performers expected tips but got not one penny.
explanation.definitionFit: Duets are pieces for two players, and here by extension the pairs who perform them.

clue.text: Bread and a knob of butter with one after church

indicators.note: the rest comes after the church abbreviation

parts.note: a pat is a small portion of butter
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Bread with a knob of butter after church.
explanation.definitionFit: A chapati is a flat unleavened Indian bread.

clue.text: Credit facility that needs smoothing over?

parts.note: CR is the accounting abbreviation for credit
facility in the sense of ease, doing something easily

explanation.surface: A credit facility, like a loan, that needs some smoothing over.
explanation.definitionFit: A crease is a fold or wrinkle, the kind of thing ironing smooths flat.

clue.text: Suppose this person gets hair cut by American soldier

parts.note: the setter speaking of themself, the first-person pronoun

indicators.note: the soldier cuts into the hair, sitting inside it

parts.note: a mane is a long head of hair
GI is the slang for an American soldier

explanation.surface: Picture someone having their hair cut by a US soldier.
explanation.definitionFit: To imagine is to suppose or assume something is so.

clue.text: Mimic having no spare time for preparation

indicators.note: the letters are prepared, made up afresh, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: An actor has no free time to rehearse an impression.
explanation.definitionFit: To impersonate someone is to imitate their voice and manner, to mimic them.
